links.outcome: Readability (FRES, FKGL) of LLM answers to patient questions on shoulder instability
links.effect: Gemini FRES 36.96, FKGL 11.92; ChatGPT OE FRES 21.90, FKGL 14.94; ChatGPT 4o FRES 24.24, FKGL 15.11; ChatGPT responses harder to read (p<0.01)
links.quote: However, responses generated by ChatGPT 4o and OE were more difficult to read than those generated by Google Gemini.

unlisted_practices: Custom GPT (orthopaedic expert plugin) versus base model for patient-education answer quality

screen.reason: Evaluates and compares the response quality and readability of different LLMs (ChatGPT-4o, ChatGPT Orthopaedic Expert plugin, and Google Gemini) on patient questions regarding anterior shoulder instability without evaluating an organizational safeguard or deployment intervention.
